title: Empty PortBindings create warning (Docker deprecates auto-backfill of empty HostIP/HostPort)
body:
### Feature request description

Docker Engine API v1.52 deprecates the automatic backfill of empty `PortBindings` lists. When a container port has an empty bindings list (e.g. `"8080/tcp": []`), Docker treats it as a single binding with an unspecified `HostIP`/`HostPort`, which publishes the port on a random host port. For API >= 1.52, `POST /containers/create` also returns a deprecation warning:

> Following container port(s) have an empty list of port-bindings: 8080/tcp. Such bindings will be discarded in a future version.

Podman does neither today. An empty bindings list is silently dropped, so the port isn't published and no warning is returned.

part of #30164
